linkedin:
> Heroku removed free dynos, free Postgres, and free Redis on November 28, 2022.

The cheapest paid options are Eco (around $5/mo for a pool of shared dyno hours) and Basic (around $7/mo per dyno), per Heroku's published usage docs. But a real app rarely stops there: a web dyno, a worker, a database, Redis, and a staging environment are each billed separately, so the practical monthly cost climbs quickly. Budget the whole stack, not one dyno.
